_comment: Model tiers per harness. Override per machine in ~/.config/agent-skills/tiers.json (deep-merged over this file). 'data' says where a brief goes when you dispatch to that harness. Claude rows use exact IDs: in Claude Code 2.1.283 the bare aliases resolve to older models (haiku -> Haiku 4.5, sonnet -> Sonnet 5).

opencode.data: depends on the model's provider: ollama/* stays local, openrouter/* goes to OpenRouter (needs providers with those names in your OpenCode config)

ollama.data: local only (no network); pull the tier models first or override them

dsh.data: cloud (the provider set in your dsh profile); check it before sending anything private
